title: Navigate Complexity
coreMove: Navigate Complexity becomes real when ambiguity, interdependence, and emergence change the next tradeoff, especially when schedule pressure tempts the team to defend the baseline.

exampleSpecs.audience: project managers defending a public launch date
exampleSpecs.stakes: a visible launch could ship with hidden adoption and integration risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A routine status update is interrupted, and the pause itself becomes the technique.

exampleSpecs.audience: analysts preparing leaders to use PMBOK principles together
exampleSpecs.stakes: leaders may treat Navigate Complexity as a stand-alone slogan
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A close observed desk moment teaches through detail without a live decision.

exampleSpecs.audience: delivery teams reviewing a failed release after schedule recovery
exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed handoff could be misread as bad execution instead of hidden complexity
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The scene opens after failure and locates the decisive misstep in the trace.

exampleSpecs.audience: delivery leads presenting to a steering group
exampleSpecs.stakes: leaders may hear schedule confidence while adoption risk grows
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The protagonist notices her own simplifying error while speaking.

exampleSpecs.audience: project managers documenting a pressure decision
exampleSpecs.stakes: leaders need a written decision that shows how complexity changed the choice
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written artifact carries the action of the scene.

exampleSpecs.stakes: two leaders face the same integration surprise with different principle use
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people face the same situation with opposite approaches and diverging outcomes.
